ChatGPT has pushed its share of AI chatbot website traffic back up to 55.5 percent, according to Similarweb. Year-over-year, though, its lead shrank sharply from 73.3 percent as Gemini doubled its share and Claude grew nearly fivefold. Mobile apps and desktop clients aren't included.

sources.title_original: AI-designed drug appears to turn back the body's biological clock in early trial
sources.summary:
A study in Nature Biotechnology suggests that rentosertib, a drug designed with AI by Insilico Medicine, may reverse markers of biological aging. Six independent aging clocks predicted that treated patients were biologically up to six years younger than the placebo group. The trial covered just 42 patients and the drug hasn't been tested in healthy people yet.

sources.title_en: New York City bans AI tools from public schools through eighth grade
sources.title_original: New York City bans AI tools from public schools through eighth grade
sources.recommend_reason_zh: 纽约市公立学校新学年起禁止约60万八年级及以下学生用AI工具，全年级禁用陪伴聊天机器人，教师能用AI备课但不能批改。市长Zohran Mamdani拒绝“不可避免”论调，家长组织Parents for AI Caution却嫌太弱，要求暂停两年。值得一读。

sources.title: AWS 开源 Kiro Crew，让 Coding Agent 异步跑起来
sources.title_zh: AWS 开源 Kiro Crew，让 Coding Agent 异步跑起来
sources.title_original: AWS 开源 Kiro Crew，让 Coding Agent 异步跑起来
sources.recommend_reason_zh: 本文报道AWS开源Kiro Crew，它源自Amazon内部MeshClaw，已有超过3.9万名内部开发者采用。该系统让多个Coding Agent跨Session、工具协同异步执行任务，支持共享记忆与MCP/Webhook集成，适用于事故调查和工单分诊等自动化场景。

stories.title: ai 时代之下，对孩子最好的托举是什么？ 1. 有钱就多吃牛羊肉，没钱就吃猪鸭鸡，实在没钱就多吃鸡蛋。 2. 晚上9点无条件睡觉，作业写不完不必强求，孩子多长高10cm，比作业重要1000倍。 3. 关注身高、体重、牙齿、面容发育，坚持体育运动，坚持户外运动。 4. 学好数学和英语就够了。 5. 在合适的启蒙年龄，一定要教孩子计算机和 ai、生理卫生相关知识。 6. 至于语文、地理、政治、历史、唐诗宋词，等孩子大了，这些他自然就会了。…

sources.summary: The above is from one of the articles listed [0]. The passage struck me because I've worked at a couple places where either or both of the below was true: - there were more people than needed for the work queue - there wasn't clarity on people's role and/or what they should be working on. I mention this b/c the problem of people finding solutions for problems that don't exist is not an AI phenomenon but rather a preexisting one. AI is certainly exacerbating the issue but it's not a new phenomeno
sources.recommend_reason_zh: 这篇来自Hacker News的评论指出，AI并非“为不存在的问题找解决方案”这一现象的根源，它只是加剧了早已存在的人手过剩与角色不清问题，提醒我们别把旧疾误当新技术特有的新症。
